name: Site ID
description: Unique identifier for the site and sample (ex. 1234_us).  If there are replicates for the sample append a letter to the end of the site ID (ex. 1234_us_a, 1234_us_b).  Use PSCIS crossing number if present and modelled_crossing_id if pscis id not present.  Choose adjacent crossing.
